Controller receipt is ok=true with code_unchanged=true and inputs_unchanged=true.
changes: Rebuilt the full accepted Table 1 Compustat panel jointly from the current local source snapshots, extending estimation-year T from 1969–2012 through 2017. The source actual-DATADATE envelope is 30Apr1955–31Mar2017; no period beyond the checked endpoint is claimed.

Kept the accepted June 30/FYE rule, horizon-specific ten-year windows, source fields and identifiers, descriptor filters, FX construction, tie rule, model terms, annual winsorization, missing-AC/TACC rule, OLS/asreg estimator, and coefficient-mean inference unchanged.

Extended copied Stata fit loops to 2017 and added native e(sample) counts, checks of the 1969/2012/2017 endpoints, and one aggregate CSV per assigned scope. The base code and output paths remain job-local; the ado path resolves to the published reconstruction ado directory.
limitations: The task sample ID compustat_forecast_eval is labeled as the later 1969–2008 forecast-error/ICC sample. The assigned fits are Table 1 coefficient fits for estimation years 1969–2012, and the accepted code uses rolling_fit_panel; the task schema allows only the former ID, so the rows retain it while this mapping discrepancy is made explicit.

The accepted attempt_02 had unresolved differences from the published Table 1: HVZ E slopes were comparatively close but AC differed; EP and RI estimates and adjusted R-squared differ, especially at horizons 2 and 3. The extension does not alter the accepted specification or attribute these gaps to vintage.

The inherited FX-only missing-AC/TACC zero-fill limitation remains: the prior audit found CAD prior-period daily-rate gaps, including 591/560/533 unique HVZ rows and 233/214/208 RI rows for horizons 1/2/3. The extended 2013–2017 period has complete required daily and monthly rate-pair coverage; all-period missing keys remain in the earlier history.

RI horizon 3 at estimation year 1969 remains underidentified because TACC is constant zero after the accepted missing-to-zero rule. The fresh pooled output omits that one coefficient vector and averages 48 qualifying annual fits, while all five added years are full rank.
